text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Employment (Composition of Offences) Regulations. Compoundable offences

The offences referred to in sections 27, 36, 52, 62, 79(1), 87, 102, 110, 112(2), 113, 113A, 117 and 122 may be compounded by the Commissioner or a Deputy Commissioner in accordance with section 147. [S 34/2024]
